title: Can Hot Water Freeze Faster Than Cold Water?
description:
Sometimes it can—but the Mpemba effect is not a universal rule.

Under some experimental conditions, initially hotter water can freeze sooner; results depend on evaporation, convection, supercooling, container and definition of “freeze.”

The effect is real in some setups but not guaranteed, and there is no single mechanism that explains every observation.

Changing only one condition can reverse which sample freezes first.
